title: Citation check loop: stalls on one search
story: Same misfiled case, but this run retries the identical search until a loop guardrail stops it. Deadlock, termination and sub-goal progress all show the stall.
content_note: Intentional negative example: a citation search loop stalls without progress. Fully fictional case names.
description: A review lead sends the draft brief to a citation extractor, then hands the four cited cases to a folder checker that searches the matter's authorities folder. One case does not match an exact search.
